name: Sigmize
author: Brainstorm Force

sections.description:
Sigmize is a comprehensive A/B testing and conversion optimization platform designed specifically for WordPress. Run split tests, track revenue with e-commerce integrations, analyze user behavior with heatmaps and session replays, and optimize your website for maximum conversions.

🚀 Key Features

A/B Testing & Variation Testing
* Create unlimited split tests and experiments
* Test page variations and element changes
* No flicker technology for seamless user experience
* Intelligent traffic distribution across variants
* Real-time experiment tracking and results

Advanced Analytics
* Heatmap Analytics – Visualize where users click, scroll, and engage
* Session Replays – Watch real user sessions to identify conversion blockers
* Track time spent, scroll depth, and page views
* Custom event tracking for advanced goals

E-Commerce Integration
* WooCommerce – Track add-to-cart and purchase completion events per variation
* SureCart – Monitor cart additions and order completions by variant
* Easy Digital Downloads (EDD) – Track digital product purchases and revenue
* Compare conversion rates and average order values across variants

Custom Goals & Events
* Page view goals
* Element click goals
* Element view goals
* Scroll depth goals
* Time spent goals
* Add to cart events
* Purchase completed events
* Custom event tracking

No Flicker Experience
* Anti-flicker technology ensures smooth variation loading
* Prevents content flash during A/B tests
* Optimized for WordPress performance

🎯 How It Works

  1. Connect to Sigmize – Link your WordPress site to your Sigmize workspace
  2. Create Experiments – Design A/B tests with multiple variations through the SaaS dashboard
  3. Set Goals – Define conversion goals (purchases, clicks, form submissions, custom events)
  4. Track Results – Monitor performance with real-time analytics, heatmaps, and session replays
  5. Optimize – Identify winning variations and implement changes

💼 Perfect For

  • E-commerce stores (WooCommerce, SureCart, EDD)
  • Marketing agencies optimizing client websites
  • SaaS companies testing landing pages
  • Bloggers improving content engagement
  • Membership sites optimizing conversion funnels

🔗 SaaS Integration

Sigmize uses a SaaS-first architecture for powerful features and scalability:

  • All experiment creation and management in your Sigmize workspace
  • Connect plugin from WordPress admin
  • Sync experiments to WordPress for frontend delivery
  • View comprehensive analytics and reports in SaaS dashboard
  • Access at https://app.sigmize.com/

🛠️ Technical Highlights

  • Lightweight frontend with cached experiments
  • Smart URL routing and variant assignment
  • No performance impact on WordPress
  • Compatible with page builders and themes
  • REST API for seamless SaaS integration

External Service Connection / Security

Sigmize connects your WordPress site with our SaaS securely. When a user initiates a connection, they are redirected to the SaaS login. Upon clicking Connect, the SaaS generates a short-lived, single-use token which is sent back to WordPress via a redirect. WordPress then verifies the token server-to-server before storing the access token and user data for future API calls. Tokens are time-limited (1–5 minutes), single-use, and encrypted in transit using HTTPS. This ensures secure authentication, prevents token reuse, and protects user data. No actions are taken by WordPress until token verification succeeds. The access token will be used to sync A/B test experiments on the WordPress site. All privacy and data handling comply with WordPress.org Plugin Guidelines.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/sigmize/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Click “Get Started Now” to connect your WordPress site
  4. Create your first experiment in the Sigmize dashboard
sections.faq:
Does Sigmize work with WooCommerce?

Yes! Sigmize has native integration with WooCommerce. Track add-to-cart events, purchase completions, conversion rates, and average order values per variation.

Can I track custom events?

Absolutely. Sigmize supports custom event tracking including page views, element clicks, scroll depth, time spent, and custom JavaScript events.

Will A/B tests cause content flicker?

No. Sigmize uses anti-flicker technology to ensure smooth variation loading without content flash.

Does it work with SureCart and Easy Digital Downloads?

Yes! Sigmize integrates with SureCart and EDD to track digital product sales, cart additions, and purchase completions.

Can I see how users interact with my site?

Yes. Use heatmaps to visualize clicks and scroll behavior, and watch session replays to see exactly how users navigate your site.

Is Sigmize compatible with page builders?

Yes. Sigmize works with all major WordPress page builders including Elementor, Beaver Builder, Divi, and others.

0.0.2

  • Fixed WordPress search action and ensured A/B testing is skipped during search mode.
  • Skipped tracking goals for renewal orders to prevent duplicate conversions.

0.0.1

  • Initial WordPress release.
  • Added support for A/B testing, heatmaps, session replays, and revenue tracking.
  • Ready for experimentation and performance analytics within WordPress sites.
